# Intuition Machine

> Intuition Machine turns AI agents and experimental workflows into reliable, governed systems that work within your enterprise architecture, follow your organisation's rules, and deliver measurable value.

Intuition Machine is an enterprise AI engineering and assurance company founded in 2015 and based in Arlington, Virginia. Its approach is Map, Build, Prove: understand the enterprise, deploy AI within it, and prove that it works. Its products are the machines for the self-learning enterprise; its research is Quaternion Process Theory of Cognition. Contact: info@intuitionmachine.com.

The full text of every page is at https://intuitionmachine.com/llms-full.txt.

## Work with us

- [The Machines](https://intuitionmachine.com/machines.html): Machines for the self-learning enterprise: eight specialised intelligence systems — Sense, Connection, Context, Judgment, Intuition, Agency, Learning and Coreography — on one Common Ground.
- [How We Work](https://intuitionmachine.com/how-we-work.html): Map, Build, Prove: how Intuition Machine turns AI experiments into governed, enterprise-ready workflows that follow your organisation's rules.
- [Your First Governed AI-Native Workflow](https://intuitionmachine.com/first-workflow.html): One business process, real enterprise systems, measurable results: a bounded AI workflow run in shadow alongside the existing one, with evidence for what comes next.
- [From ExO 3.0 to Production](https://intuitionmachine.com/exo.html): What ExO 3.0 is — MTP, DRIVE, SHAPE, the Intelligence Stack, the Edge Twin and REWRITE — and the engineering and assurance it takes to build it in existing enterprises.

## Research

- [Research](https://intuitionmachine.com/research.html): Quaternion Process Theory of Cognition: the machine-checked theory underneath Intuition Machine's engineering.
- [AI-Native Organisations](https://intuitionmachine.com/ai-native.html): AI-native organisations have a specifiable shape: six layers from an invariant core to a licensed saboteur, each with a formal counterpart in QPT.
- [The Kernel — Quaternion Process Theory of Cognition](https://intuitionmachine.com/kernel.html): The QML kernel: three spine levels, four attentional columns, and one generative operator from which the rest of the theory is built.
- [The Loops — Quaternion Process Theory of Cognition](https://intuitionmachine.com/loops.html): Twelve recurring processes, each written as a word: a string of moves on the matrix that closes back on its start cell.
- [Diagnosis — Quaternion Process Theory of Cognition](https://intuitionmachine.com/diagnosis.html): Pathologies as syntactic edits to healthy words, and the seven-layer diagnostic that locates them.
- [Video — Quaternion Process Theory of Cognition](https://intuitionmachine.com/video.html): A 36-part video series working through Quaternion Process Theory: the kernel, the loops, the pathologies and the dispatch extensions.

## Publications

- [Books](https://intuitionmachine.com/books.html): Books, pattern languages and field guides on deep learning, generative AI and agentic systems, published through Gumroad. Several are pay-what-you-want.
- [Writing](https://intuitionmachine.com/writing.html): Recent essays from Intuition Machine on Medium: patterns, methodology and strategy in deep learning, generative AI and agentic systems.
- [Explorations](https://intuitionmachine.com/explorations.html): Interactive companions to the theory — the Semiosis Atlas and a four-dimensional chess variant — and narrated films made from Artificial Intuition, Empathy, Fluency and Creativity.
